param.label: Minimum number of samples (integer > 1)
param.help: Set the minimum number of samples in which a ASV/cluster must be detected to be kept. Only ASVs/clusters found in at least this number of samples will be retained. Leave empty to skip prevalence filtering.

validator.message: To be effective this threshold need to be higher than 1

section.name: replicate_prevalence
section.title: Prevalence by sample groups (metadata file required)

param.label: Sample replicates group (.tsv)
param.help: First column indicates the sample name, and the second column the group name.

param.label: Minimum prevalence
param.help: Apply the prevalence filter within sample groups defined in a metadata file. The metadata file must include a column specifying the sample groups (batches). Keep ASV/cluster present in at least this proportion of replicates in at least one group (must be a proportion between 0 and 1). Leave empty to skip prevalence filtering.

param.name: abundance_unit_type
param.label: Set the minimum ASV/cluster abundance, as a proportion or as a count. We recommend using a proportion of 0.00005.
Minimum abundance proportion to keep ASV/cluster
param.help: Leave empty to skip this abundance filtering. For example, 0.00005 (recommended by Bokulich et al., 2013) keeps ASVs/clusters representing at least 0.005% of all sequences.

validator.message: The abundance proportion threshold must be strictly greater than 0 and less than 1, otherwise nothing or everything will be removed.

param.label: Minimum number of sequences to keep ASVs/clusters
param.help: Leave empty to skip this abundance filtering. For example, 2 keeps ASVs/cluster with at least two sequences (i.e. removes single singleton)

validator.message: To be effective, this threshold must be greater than 1. A value of 2 removes ASVs/clusters containing only one sequence across all samples.

param.label: Number of most abundant ASVs/clusters to keep
param.help: Leave empty to skip this filtering. Keeps the N most abundant ASVs/clusters.

param.name: which_contaminant_source
param.label: Search for contaminant ASVs/clusters
param.help: Use either your own contaminant FASTA file or one provided by FROGS.
param.option: Use contaminant FASTA file from FROGS
Use your contaminant FASTA file from history

param.name: server_contaminant
param.label: Contaminant reference database
param.help: For example, the phiX database (phiX is a control commonly added in Illumina sequencing).

validator.message: A built-in database is not available

param.name: own_contaminant
param.label: Select a contaminant reference from history
param.help: Provide your own contaminant reference FASTA file from history.
